Marie: Quick check — I walked the suppression preview with keyboard-only and found the toggle order confusing. top->bottom focus goes: channel chip, preview dropdown, then ... back to header. not ideal. :thinking: Nisha: can you repro steps? which browser/AT? Marie: Chrome + VoiceOver on mac. Steps: Open alert detail → Click "Preview" → Tab through suppression controls. Jake: I can repro in Safari too. The issue is the preview panel isn't in DOM order with the header controls. Sam: Proposed quick fix: move the preview panel DOM node to be directly after header and add `aria-hidden` when closed. Also add `aria-expanded` on the preview button. Sam: Code snippet: ```
...
``` Nisha: For VoiceOver the important part is announcing when panel opens. Add an `aria-live="polite"` region for the preview summary. Marie: sounds good. Also copy tweak — current label "Suppress notifications for" reads technical. Suggest "Pause alerts for" (shorter). Jake: I prefer "Pause alerts for" too. Less cognitive load and matches product wording elsewhere. UX-Bot: uploaded a quick Figma update: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/suppression-quick-add — added 4 presets, keyboard flows, and updated copy. Marie: Quick question — if we change label, do we need translation tickets? probably yes. @Nisha can you queue i18n? Nisha: Yep. I'll open a ticket and add context strings. Also adding accessibility notes: focus trap when panel open, Escape to close, ensure focus returns to Preview button. Sam: I'll push a small PR with DOM reorder + aria attrs, will add unit test for `aria-expanded` state. Jake: can we add a visual affordance for focus (outline) in dark mode? current focus is subtle. Marie: yes, we'll use 3px solid accent color per the tokens. add to PR. Nisha: I'll validate with VoiceOver after PR merges. If all green, we can ship in next patch release. Marie: great. Thanks all :thumbsup: UX-Bot: deploy-preview available at https://staging.redwood.ai/preview/suppression-191010 — please test keyboard + screenreader. Jake: testing now :eyes: Marie: last note — for A/B: let's try new copy for 2 weeks, measure click-to-suppress conversion. I'll add to product board. Nisha: noted. thanks!
